items.description: Observations to adjoining borough of Islington for hybrid planning application for demolition of existing buildings and comprehensive redevelopment comprising full planning permission for all elements (other than Block 9 submitted in outline with appearance reserved) for four blocks ranging from 7 to 9 storeys plus two towers of 42 storeys (up to 155m) and 36 storeys (up to 137m), providing up to 995 residential units; commercial floorspace (Class B1) up to 5,000sqm; affordable workspace (Class B1); relocated data centre; flexible retail/financial and professional services/restaurant/ café/drinking establishment/health centre floorspace (Class A1/A2/A3/A4/D1) up to 3,650sqm; crèche (Class D1); and hotel (Class C1) of up to 190 beds; together with public open spaces, up to 1,223 cycle spaces, 250 car parking spaces and ancillary floorspace within a basement and other associated works.
